manifest.sampling: equal train and new-validation token quotas across fixed-seed shuffled source shards; shuffled row groups and rows
manifest.split: fixed normalized-text SHA256 threshold independent of budgets; all pilot validation text hashes/URLs reserved first
manifest.packing: document text + EOS, concatenated within each split; no cross-document attention mask

data_comparison.train_sampling: three token-offset probes at 10%,50%,90% of each shard quota (342 documents); not a uniform-document or complete domain census
data_comparison.source_sampling_note: Both splits cover the same 114 source shards with nearly equal token quotas; validation includes 262144 preserved pilot tokens and quota-truncated prefixes. Domain proportions cannot be established from the 342-document train sample.

interpretation_limits: Training losses use the compiled training forward; validation uses native eager. Their arithmetic difference is descriptive, not a calibrated generalization gap.
Standard errors assume independent updates and ignore shuffled-block dependence; they are nominal summaries, not formal significance tests.
Only successful-update gradient norms are logged. The failure step does not have a saved norm/loss, so nonfinite rates among successful updates exclude that failure.
Warmup, elapsed training exposure and validation loss move together; these observations do not establish learning-rate causality.
Epoch two reuses the same 5B token blocks in a fresh permutation. Epoch differences combine parameter changes, learning-rate stage and batch composition.
